title: Concession agreements

voice.rule: No voice: the Parties act in the third person (the Agency shall …).

spelling.rule: British -ise (authorised, utilisation, organisation), although the firm's agreement bases still carry -ize: change it as you write.

cross_refs.rule: Articles and Sections in the body (Article 30 (Dispute Resolution), Section 10.3.3); "Clause" and "Paragraph" only inside the Schedules; Schedules lettered A to Y, the schedule heading with an en dash: Schedule B – Specific Definitions.

headings.rule: Title Case with every word capitalised, small words too: Grant Of Rights, Deposits & Withdrawals From Accounts. Schedules: Schedule A – [Title].

dates.preamble: is entered into on this [Date] of [Month], [Year] at [Location], Pakistan:

parties_close.text: (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns)

rollup.text: (the Agency and the Concessionaire are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties and each individually as a Party).

now_therefore.text: Now, therefore, this agreement witnesseth and it is hereby agreed to by and between the Parties as follows:

testimonium.text: In Witness Whereof, the Parties hereto have caused this Agreement to be executed on the day, month and year first above mentioned.

execution.text: As [Party] / For and on behalf of [●] through its authorised signatory / Name: / Designation: / in the presence of / Witnesses: / Name: / Address: / CNIC / Passport No:

governing_law.text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

arbitration.text: No default: the seat, the rules (Arbitration Act, 1940 or institutional, e.g. SIAC), the number of arbitrators and the venue are always asked as a drafting question; the firm's files differ (a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration Act, 1940; a board of three under the Arbitration Act, 1940; SIAC seated in Singapore).

preamble.text: This ‘Concession Agreement’ (this Agreement) is entered into on this [Date] of [Month], [Year] at [Location], Pakistan:

parties.text: [●] having its offices at [●] for and on behalf of the [●] (the Agency); And [●], a company incorporated under the Applicable Laws of Pakistan, having its registered office located at [●] (the Concessionaire, which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns),

carve_outs.text: provided, however, that … / provided further, that … / Notwithstanding anything to the contrary set out herein …

banned.reason: The firm's party clause reads (the [●], which expression shall, where the context so permits, be deemed to mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns), not "(hereinafter referred to as …". The roll-up "are hereinafter collectively referred to as the Parties" is the firm's own.
The pointer reads "shall bear the meaning ascribed thereto in …", without "as".

banned.pattern: \bha(?:s|ve) the meanings? given to (?:it|them|that term|the term|such term)\b
banned.reason: "has the meaning given to it in" is another firm's pointer; the firm writes "shall have (or bear) the meaning ascribed thereto in …".
Figures in brackets are not zero-padded: five (5) days, not five (05) days.

tells_of_counterparty.tell: "has the meaning given to it in" pointers
"(hereinafter referred to as the X which expression shall mean and include …)" with no "where the context so permits"
parties called "the Company" rather than by role (the Concessionaire, the Project Company)
money with the words first: Pakistani Rupees [words] (PKR [●])

defined_terms.pointer_formula: shall have the meaning ascribed thereto in Schedule B (Specific Definitions)
defined_terms.lead_in: In this Agreement (including the Recitals), unless the context shall otherwise require:
defined_terms.rule: Bold at the point of definition, unquoted, initial capitals on every significant word; single curly quotes mark a term introduced in prose (this ‘Concession Agreement’). Capitals must match the definition exactly.

money.rule: Follow the slot: the master's slots read PKR [●] (Pakistani Rupees [●] only) and PKR [●]/- (Pakistani Rupees [words] only), lower-case "only".

notes: The master's wording is the firm's: fill its slots and change nothing else; its -ize spelling is changed only where a clause is newly written.
The master's default arbitration seat is not a default: arbitration is always asked.
"GoS" names in the master (GoS Default Termination Amount, the GoS Agency) become Government terms.
